+  After the peer is lost the station is grandmaster, so CLKV "healthy" no

+## Changes
+
+### Commit 1, #84: the grandmaster role is synchronised
+
+- `hdl/ucode/gen_gptp_ucode.py:1738` `prog_become` sets sync-ok with the
+  master bit: `e_flags(p, andm=FL_ASCAP_C, orm=FL_AMGM_C | FL_SYNCOK_C)`. The
+  becoming-grandmaster commit also changes the published grandmaster identity,
+  which arms the parent's 0.25 s Annex B.1.1 holdover (`KL_ptp_clock_validity`
+  `gm_id_i != gm_r` and the shadow's `pub_disc_o`); nothing in the parent was
+  changed, so that holdover stays.
+- `hdl/ucode/gen_gptp_ucode.py:1990` `prog_leg_srto`: a Sync receipt timeout
+  no longer clears a master's sync-ok. BECOME disarms timer slot 4, but
+  `KL_gptp_timer` cannot recall an expiry already queued behind BECOME's event,
+  so the leg keeps bit 3 exactly where bit 1 stands:
+  `flags & ((flags << 2) | 7)`, `:2002`. Branch-free because the ROM packer has
+  no gap for the 9-word gated form (7 words fit; measured: first-fit-decreasing
+  refuses 8 or more).
+- `hdl/ucode/gen_gptp_ucode.py:505` `SYNCOK_BY_AMGM_C = 2` with an assert that
+  it carries bit 1 onto bit 3.
+- Images regenerated by their own recipes: `tb/verilator/engine/gptp_ucode.hex`,
+  `tb/verilator/ucpu/gptp_ucode.hex`, `tb/tsngen/gptp_ucode.hex`,
+  `syn/ooc/work/gptp_ucode.hex` (1015 of 1024 words used).
+- Docs: `docs/INTEGRATION.md:536` "Grandmaster synchronization", `:302`;
+  `docs/HDL_DEVELOPER.md:137`; `docs/TEST_DEVELOPER.md:117-119`;
+  `docs/SOURCE_EVIDENCE.md` anchor moved.
+- Tests: `tb/verilator/engine/sim_main.cpp` (below) and

+### #84: the grandmaster role counts as synchronised
+
+A grandmaster's own time is the domain's time. IEEE 1722-2016 4.4.4.7 makes
+tu mark a discontinuity, not the role (see also Milan v1.2 4.3.5.2).
+
+- `prog_become` now sets sync-ok (flags bit 3) together with the master bit,
+  so the parent's tu is 0 during mastership.
+- The Milan v1.2 Annex B.1.1 holdover stays. The parent arms it on a
+  grandmaster change. Mastership arms it only when its commit replaces a peer
+  grandmaster with thisClock.
+- When the publication already names thisClock (from reset, or after a self
+  publication), the mastership commit changes no grandmaster and arms no
+  holdover. tu then falls at that commit unless an earlier holdover is still
+  running.
+- A Sync receipt timeout no longer clears a master's sync-ok. BECOME disarms
+  the watch, but a timer expiry already queued behind BECOME's event cannot
+  be recalled, so the receipt-timeout leg keeps bit 3 exactly where bit 1
+  stands.
+- Handing mastership to a peer still clears sync-ok, in the same commit that
+  names the new grandmaster.
+- Unchanged: before mastership (no asCapable port yet) the self publication of
+  #82 keeps its reset flags, so tu stays 1 there.
+
+### #85: the published path is the received pathSequence plus thisClock
+
+IEEE 802.1AS-2020 10.3.13.2.4 f) 5) and 10.3.9.23: a slave port copies the
+received pathSequence and appends thisClock unless it is empty.
+
+- The engine's path-staging write (region 3, word 7) now publishes count + 1
+  with thisClock after the received entries. A directly attached grandmaster
+  publishes [GM, thisClock].
+- An absent PathTrace still publishes count 0.
+- Eight or more received entries still publish their first eight: the
+  publication carries eight entries, and widening it would be a port change.
+- No port or parameter changes. The meaning of `pub_path_count_o` and
+  `pub_path_o` changes as #85 requires: the count now includes thisClock.

[31:16] is the major redesign number; [15:0] is the flat, continuously increasing compliance revision. The ENTITY firmware_version renders this as major.minor.rev. 0x005C corrects what three RO status fields MEAN (#471, #472). LWSRP_STATUS 0x694 [3:0] describes ONE subject again - the Listener attribute registered on talker source 0 - so [1:0] is its four-packed value, [2] "registered" counts Asking Failed IN, and [3] "ready" is the Ready/Ready Failed pair; the substituted plane had [2] reading bit 1 of that value and [1:0]/[3] describing sink 0's own declaration instead. ACMPL_STATE 0x6A4 [6] "TalkerAdvertise registered" compares sink 0's registered Talker code against ADVERTISE, where it had taken bit 1, the FAILED bit. No CSR address, width or access moves: 0x005B's SET_SAMPLING_RATE list check is unchanged and this is a value change in four bits of two existing read-only words. The register occupies four bytes and no CSR addresses move.  0x005E (issue #358) ADDS ONE ADDRESS: `A_GPTP_LAT` at 0x7F0, RO live, writes inert, option OFF zero - the timestamp latency corrections the fabric gPTP plane is applying, {ingress_ns[31:16], egress_ns[15:0]}. Nothing else moves, and the ONLY live consumer of a latency correction remains the plane: 0x540 and 0x544 stay inert scratch. 0x005D was never released: a parallel lane held it and landed as 0x005F.  0x005F lands the saved-state SNAPSHOT OWNERSHIP contract (#484, docs/design/SAVED_STATE_SNAPSHOT_OWNERSHIP.md). PP_STAT 0x924 gains [11] nvm_pend: accepted work that no verified slot holds and nvm_dirty does not report - a change the producer still holds, or a record whose logical write has not completed - so the durable reading of the saved-state page's 9.3 becomes (backed 1, dirty 0, stale 0) AND pend 0. Nothing here loosens the bit: 0 still means no accepted work is outstanding. #502 closes the original marks' program-tail window: accepted name writes and actual parent phase-5 map writes now raise pending. Unchanged maps raise nothing; marks still delimit command completion. No CSR address, width, access or OTHER field moves.
